scripts.dev:worker: pnpm run build && wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:worker: pnpm run types && vite build && vitest run
scripts.build: pnpm run types && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.check: pnpm run types && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/require-public-site-url.mjs && pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
